Welcome to Niharika's personal blog—an intersection of data, technology, and creativity. Niharika is a Staff Data Scientist with a nine-year track record spanning Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Causal Inference, Deep Learning, and Generative AI.

Niharika currently leads the architecture, deployment, and evaluation of GenAI platforms and consumer AI agents at SoFi, building on years managing data science teams focused on Generative AI, Consumer Behavior Analytics, and Predictive Modeling within the domains of eCommerce and Ad Tech. Her passion lies in translating quantifiable data into actionable insights that positively shape businesses. Niharika brings a unique blend of market awareness and technical prowess, ensuring the delivery of user-centric products and solutions.

When not innovating on data platforms, Niharika unwinds by molding clay on a potter's wheel and immersing herself in the strokes of paint on canvas.

Explore Niharika's blog to embark on a journey where data points weave stories, and algorithmic solutions propel us toward a clearer, more informed future.
